sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has become a trending topic in the US, with over 10,000 searches reported by Google. The film has been praised for its grounded and mature take on the Spider-Man story, according to Rotten Tomatoes.

sections.heading: Critical Reception
paragraphs: Rotten Tomatoes has published first reviews of 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', highlighting it as the most grounded and mature Spider-Man story yet. The New York Times also reviewed the film, posing the question, 'Can We Do Whatever a Spider Can?', indicating a positive reception.

paragraphs: Yahoo has ranked every Spider-Man movie by Rotten Tomatoes score after the release of 'Brand New Day', showing the film's immediate impact on the franchise's legacy.
